ITEM 1 | Pale orange-pink flaky pieces with light golden-brown edges and a dotted texture, some bits crumbly, moderate moisture, sitting at upper-left of plate, approx 8 cm across and 2 cm tall | 110
ITEM 2 | Shredded brown-tan meat pieces with darker seared edges and light glossy sheen, fibrous strands, piled center-left beside the pale flaky piece, approx 7 cm across and 2 cm tall | 100
ITEM 3 | Small whole cherry tomatoes, bright red and glossy with smooth skins, a few split, cluster at upper-center near cucumber, each about 2.5 cm across | 80
ITEM 4 | Small red chopped tomato pieces with seeds and moist juicy look, scattered on the left edge of the flaky item | 15
ITEM 5 | Cucumber rounds and half-moons, pale green with darker green skin edges, watery sheen, cut into slices about 0.5 cm thick, fanned along right edge, roughly 8 cm by 6 cm footprint | 90
ITEM 6 | Thinly sliced radishes, bright magenta-red skin with white interiors, crisp, arranged in overlapping rounds at lower right, about 6 cm across | 40
ITEM 7 | Two small roasted potatoes, golden-brown with crisp browned skins and matte surface, roughly 3.5 cm diameter each, lower center | 90
ITEM 8 | Mixed salad leaves: crisp pale green romaine pieces with light yellow-green inner leaves and darker green sturdy leaves, dry surface, lower-left, about 10 cm by 9 cm footprint, 1–2 cm tall | 60
